1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The birth skeleton is where creation meets validity and authorship; the gate keeps it a surface over the creation verb, the document shape, the schema, and the kind separation without re-deciding any of them. Its five edges span two cells — four prose parents (natural→natural) and one artifact parent (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
